Perform a privacy review of: <feature/change>

Inspect what personal/sensitive data is collected, observed, stored, logged, transmitted, retained, displayed, or deleted.

Check:
- necessity/data minimization;
- user awareness/consent where applicable;
- access/authorization boundaries;
- secret/private-data leakage through logs/errors/tests;
- retention/deletion behavior;
- local vs remote transmission;
- screenshots/audio/video/input/event metadata;
- defaults and failure behavior;
- documentation transparency.

Return concrete privacy risks and the smallest mitigation/test for each. Do not propose hidden capture or suppression of required privacy indicators.
